gap: No result ChatGPT got states that SoundGuys' lab scored the open-ear Soundcore AeroFit 2 at 1.8/5 on MDAQS against 3.8/5 for the sealed Soundcore Space One, or that SoundGuys measured the Space One's ANC making ambient noise sound about one-quarter as loud for 42 h 57 min on one charge, or that its test fixture cannot measure a bone conduction headset's frequency response at all.
standout_why: ChatGPT ran no searches and got no result pages, so it cited no rival page. Its answer only says bone conduction has 'weaker bass, less detail' and that sealed headphones have 'good' noise isolation. It gives no measured figure from any named lab, so these named numbers are new. They quantify a claim ChatGPT already made but do not reverse it.
decides: This confirms the split our page already makes. For music and office work, the sealed Space One measured more than twice the open-ear AeroFit 2's MDAQS score (3.8 vs 1.8 out of 5) and cut ambient noise to about a quarter of its loudness. SoundGuys and headphonecheck both say the Shokz OpenRun Pro 2 blocks nothing by design, and SoundGuys could not even put its sound on a frequency-response chart. So bone conduction stays the pick only when awareness outdoors matters more than sound quality.

findings.label: Battery, SoundGuys lab test, ANC on
findings.source_title: Anker Soundcore Space One review (SoundGuys, Chase Bernath, 2024-11-13)
findings.note: One charge with ANC on. The review gives no playback volume. Anker claims 40 h with ANC on. The SoundGuys battery score is 9.8/10.

findings.label: Noise cancelling, SoundGuys lab
findings.value: Ambient noise about 1/4 as loud with ANC at maximum; score 8.0/10, beats 36% of over-ears
findings.note: Quote: 'most noise around you will only sound about one-quarter as loud as without the headphones.' The dB chart did not render in the page text.

findings.label: MDAQS sound quality, SoundGuys lab
findings.note: MDAQS is SoundGuys' perceptual audio-quality model (1-5). The page labels it 'Below avg, beats 35% of over-ear headphones'.

findings.label: Battery, headphonecheck test
findings.value: 58 h at high volume; 37 h with max ANC + wind noise reduction; 95 min full recharge
findings.source_title: Soundcore Space One review (headphonecheck.com, Maike Paeßens, last updated 2023-08-30)
findings.note: The page does not describe the test method.

findings.label: MDAQS sound quality, SoundGuys lab
findings.source_title: Anker Soundcore AeroFit 2 review (SoundGuys, Dave Carr, 2024-10-29)
findings.note: SoundGuys says the measured response is 'severely compromised in all but a small section of the midrange' because the open design has no seal. It rated the AeroFit 2 5.3/10, 'Not recommended'. Its battery test was still pending, and it did not measure isolation.

findings.label: MDAQS / noise cancelling, SoundGuys lab
findings.value: MDAQS 2.4/5 overall; noise cancelling 8.5/10, beats 70% of over-ears
findings.source_title: Anker Soundcore Space One Pro review (SoundGuys, Dave Carr, 2025-09-25)
findings.note: The MDAQS chart caption names the original Space One, while the text attributes the score to the Pro, so treat 2.4 as uncertain. SoundGuys measured 'significant over-emphasis in sub-bass' and a treble spike at 6 kHz. Its battery test was still pending.

findings.label: Lab measurability, SoundGuys
findings.value: No frequency-response or isolation measurement possible
findings.source_title: Shokz OpenRun Pro 2 review (SoundGuys, Lil Katz, 2024-11-13)
findings.note: SoundGuys says its fixture 'cannot accurately measure the headphones' frequency response'. It shows no isolation chart because the headset doesn't 'do anything to block out sound'. Overall 7.3/10, beats 88% of bone conduction headphones.

findings.label: Battery, SoundGuys
findings.value: 12 h; battery score 7.9/10, beats 63% of bone conduction headphones
findings.note: The text says 'lasting 12 hours instead of 10' but gives no test conditions, so the 12 h may restate Shokz's claim. Fast charge listed as 5 min = 150 min playback.
